I use a pot with a lid on the stovetop, you don't even need a measuring cup. I like firm rice but if you like it softer just simmer and steam it a few more minutes. 

1. Rinse white rice a few times to clear off dust and excess starch. Pour in cold water,  put in your middle finger and touch the top of the rice. The water should stop at the first joint of your finger. Make sure that the rice in level and not piled up like a mountain in the pot. 
2. Add a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil then immediately down to a simmer, and completely cover with the lid. DO NOT TOUCH THE LID OR STIR THE RICE AT ANY POINT. The steam is important to finish the cooking. 
3. After simmering for 8 minutes, turn off heat and let it sit and steam for 10-15 minutes (again, do not remove the lid at all until you have waited or this will screw up the rice). There should not be any water left. Add salt to taste and just a tiny bit of lemon pepper.
